prompt:
Read this message from a charity donor and extract the donation.
Copy amount_quote character for character out of the message. Do not tidy it, do not convert it, do not translate it. If the message states no amount, return amount 0 and an empty amount_quote.

Message:

donor.description: name as written, or empty if none given

purpose.description: what the donation is earmarked for, or empty

anonymous.description: true if the sender asked not to be named

amount_quote.description: the exact characters from the input that state the amount, copied verbatim

runs.why: Ordinary case, lowercase currency, written the way people actually type.

runs.message: Sending 40 EUR for the winter fund, please keep me anonymous
runs.why: Names a currency that is not the local one, and asks to stay unnamed.

runs.message: bugün 1.250,50 TL havale ettim, dekontu sonra atarım
runs.why: European decimal comma with a thousands dot: 1.250,50 is not 1.25.

runs.message: Ben Ayşe, çocuklara kırtasiye için 500 lira gönderdim
runs.why: Names the donor inside the sentence, and writes the currency as a word.
A promise, not a donation. There is no amount to read.

runs.message: I gave 100 dollars last week, that is about 3400 lira right?
runs.why: Two numbers, one of them a conversion the sender did in their head.
